detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for packages flagged by automated malware detection systems, especially those with suspicious or typosquatted names. Use repository firewalls to quarantine and review new or unknown packages before allowing them into the build pipeline. Manual review is recommended for any package flagged as suspicious or malicious.
